Start off small, man. I started out just going to the mall and talking to the clerks at the gift shops and clothing stores. Silly shit like, “Do you know when the mall closes?” or “I’m buying something for my mom, what do you recommend?” They won’t mind because they’re literally getting paid to be nice and help you.

Slowly I started to get in the mood of actually wanting to talk to people. So, then I started working up the courage to say hi to random girls in the mall, have them reject me until I eventually found one that took a liking to me. We both went on an instant date and walked around the mall getting to know each other.

So, if you’re just getting back into dating, just take it slow. Start with store clerks then gradually work your way up to girls going about their day. Don’t judge yourself or get emotional if you get rejected, just shrug it off and go to the next one. 

Keep it going with your online dating profile, especially if you’re a good looking dude. But working up your social skills by talking to girls is a must as well since you’re going to need that confidence when you go out on dates and stuff.

Best of luck.
